inputs.text: Black spade marks ONLY on him; red diamond marks ONLY on her; no letters or text anywhere. Stained glass style depiction of a grand ball embrace, intricate details, vibrant colors: the spade king with short silver-grey hair, black spade crown and black-silver armor holds the diamond queen with very long red-orange hair, diamond tiara and white gown in a moonlit palace ballroom, her arms visible around his shoulders with defined hands, marble floor, crystal chandeliers and tall windows, every element cut colored glass with black lead came in ruby, silver, midnight blue and gold, glowing with its own light
